back_notes.chrome.copy.done: "कॉपी हो गया" mixes gender/agreement colloquially (should be "हो गई" for a feminine noun is not at issue; reads fine but casual).
back_notes.chrome.docs.full: Both "दस्तावेज़" and the short form "डॉक्स" exist; "दस्तावेज़" repeated for full/aria.
back_notes.home.hero.span-2: "न अकाउंट, न टेलीमेट्री" is idiomatic but terse; fine.
back_notes.home.p-mac.li-5: A very long single sentence with nested relative clauses.
back_notes.home.why.h2-1: "हर एक का हल कैसा दिखता है" reads naturally but is slightly colloquial.
back_notes.home.why-cache.figcaption-1: The parenthetical gloss for 'prefill' ('its prompt is read in the cache') reads oddly / is imprecise in Hindi; 'वहाँ' and 'जिस रेप्लिका पर' sentence is also clumsy.
back_notes.home.open-source.p-2: The sentence is an extended noun phrase without a verb in the first part.
back_notes.common.in-words: "शब्दों में:" is a literal label for text description.
back_notes.clients.claude-code.req.relay_key: "(May relay)" left untranslated in Hindi text.
back_notes.clients.anthropic-sdk.req.relay_key: "(May relay)" left untranslated in Hindi text.
back_notes.clients.grok-cli.mode.community.desc: "जैसे vLLM उन्हें स्ट्रीम करता है" is loosely connected.
back_notes.gpu-monitoring.img-2.alt: "रेत-घड़ी बैज" is a literal compound for hourglass.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.dd-5: "यह रिलीज़" (this release) is a bare fragment without context.
back_notes.features.h3-1: "प्रॉक्सी उसे अनुरोध भेजती रही" uses feminine for proxy; fine, but ambiguous with "agent".
back_notes.features.td-6: Table cell is a bare noun phrase, no verb.
back_notes.faq.a-4: Quoted English flag "May relay to Anthropic" left untranslated.
back_notes.faq.a-5: "पास-थ्रू हुए अनुरोध की कोई भी चीज़" is vague.
back_notes.faq.a-6: "बिना बदलाव के चलते हैं" / "मंकीपैचिंग" transliterated jargon.
back_notes.faq.a-7: Quoted English flag untranslated; "जिसकी जगह ... docker load लेता है" is a long relative clause.
